title: The Rusted Titan
text: A war machine the size of a tower lies on its side in the slag, rusted solid, its great hands clawing at the earth, its plates scarred with old wounds. Deep in its chest its heart still glows, pulsing slow as sleep.

options.label: The strongest pries out the titan's heart while it still sleeps.

outcomes.text: It comes free, warm as a coal. The glow goes out of the titan's eyes.

options.label: The cleverest studies how it was made, so the House may make its like.

outcomes.text: The old forge-craft goes home to the House's smiths, who dream of iron hands for weeks.

options.label: Strip the titan's plates; iron like that would arm a House.

outcomes.text: You take a great deal of iron. The heart pulses a little faster as you work.
